changes.before: This policy states how the organisation protects the confidentiality, integrity and availability of its information.
changes.after: This policy states how the organisation protects the confidentiality, integrity and availability of its information, and who is accountable for each part of that protection.

changes.before:
The management of the organisation is accountable for information security.

* Every system and every set of data has an owner.
* Access is given by need and withdrawn when the need ends.
* Security incidents are reported to the security office without delay.
changes.after:
The management of the organisation is accountable for information security and reviews it every year.

* Every system and every set of data has an owner who answers for its protection.
* Access is given by need and withdrawn when the need ends.
* Security incidents are reported to the security office without delay.
* Suppliers that process our information are bound to the same rules.
* A change of the security rules is released only after the review of the Chief Information Security Officer.
